supervise students: During the school trip, three teachers will supervise students to make sure nobody gets lost in the museum.
校外教學期間，三位老師會監督學生，確保沒有人在博物館裡走失。
supervise construction: The engineer visits the site every morning to supervise construction of the new library and check the workers' safety.
工程師每天早上到工地監工新圖書館的建造，並檢查工人的安全。
supervise a thesis: Professor Lin agreed to supervise a thesis on climate change, meeting the student every week to discuss her progress.
林教授同意指導一篇關於氣候變遷的論文，每週與學生見面討論進度。
closely supervised: New workers in the factory are closely supervised during their first month so that they do not make dangerous mistakes.
工廠的新員工在第一個月受到嚴密監督，以免犯下危險的錯誤。
supply electricity: After the typhoon, the power company worked all night to supply electricity to the homes in the mountain village again.
颱風過後，電力公司徹夜工作，讓山區村莊的住家恢復供電。
supply the demand: The bakery hired two more bakers because it could not supply the demand for its popular pineapple cakes.
這家麵包店又雇了兩位烘焙師，因為它無法滿足對其熱門鳳梨酥的需求。
supply information: The website can supply information about bus times, so you can check when the next bus will arrive.
這個網站可以提供公車時刻的資訊，所以你可以查詢下一班公車何時抵達。
supply and demand: When too many farmers grow cabbages, prices fall; this is the basic law of supply and demand.
當太多農夫種植高麗菜時，價格就會下跌；這就是供需的基本法則。
supply goods: That factory in Taichung supplies goods to many convenience stores across Taiwan every single day.
台中那家工廠每天都向全台許多便利商店供貨。
in short supply: Because of the dry weather, water is in short supply this summer, and people are asked to take shorter showers.
由於天氣乾燥，今年夏天水供不應求，大家被要求縮短淋浴時間。
support a family: After his father got sick, the young man worked two jobs to support a family of five.
父親生病後，這位年輕人兼兩份工作來養活一家五口。
support a theory: The scientists found new fossils that support a theory about how birds developed from small dinosaurs.
科學家發現了新的化石，支持了一個關於鳥類如何從小型恐龍演化而來的理論。
support the weight: This old wooden bridge cannot support the weight of a truck, so drivers must take another road.
這座老舊的木橋無法承受卡車的重量，所以駕駛必須改走別條路。
support a team: My whole family loves baseball, and we always support a team from our hometown, cheering loudly at every game.
我們全家都熱愛棒球，我們總是支持家鄉的球隊，每場比賽都大聲加油。
support a claim: She showed clear photos and receipts to support a claim that the shop had sold her a broken phone.
她出示清楚的照片和收據，來佐證她的說法：那家店賣給她一支壞掉的手機。
support oneself: While studying in Taipei, Amy worked part-time at a café to support herself without asking her parents for money.
在台北念書時，艾美在咖啡館打工來自力更生，不向父母要錢。
moral support: I went with my best friend to her job interview just to give her some moral support.
我陪我最好的朋友去面試，只是為了給她一些精神支持。
suppress a yawn: The speech was so long and boring that I had to suppress a yawn so the principal would not notice.
演講又長又無聊，我只好忍住哈欠，免得校長注意到。
suppress the truth: The company tried to suppress the truth about the polluted river, but a reporter finally told the public.
這家公司試圖隱瞞河川遭污染的真相，但一位記者最終告訴了大眾。
suppress a rebellion: The king sent thousands of soldiers to suppress a rebellion that had started among the poor farmers in the north.
國王派出數千名士兵去鎮壓北方貧困農民之間爆發的叛亂。
suppress emotions: Many boys are taught to suppress emotions like sadness and never cry, which can be bad for their health.
許多男孩被教導要壓抑悲傷之類的情緒、絕不哭泣，這可能對他們的健康有害。
suppress evidence: The judge warned that anyone who tried to suppress evidence or hide documents would be punished by law.
法官警告，任何試圖隱匿證據或藏匿文件的人都會受到法律制裁。
suppress a laugh: When the teacher's wig fell off, I had to cover my mouth to suppress a laugh during the lesson.
當老師的假髮掉下來時，我上課中只好摀住嘴巴忍住笑。
the problem surfaced: Everything seemed fine at first, but the problem surfaced when it rained and water came through the new roof.
起初一切似乎都很好，但下雨時水從新屋頂滲進來，問題就浮現了。
surface for air: Whales can stay underwater for a long time, but they must surface for air every twenty minutes or so.
鯨魚可以在水下待很久，但牠們大約每二十分鐘就必須浮出水面換氣。
rumors surfaced: Last week rumors surfaced online that the popular singer would quit the band, but she said they were false.
上週網路上浮現謠言，說那位當紅歌手將退出樂團，但她表示那些都是假的。
on the surface: On the surface, the two sisters seem very different, but deep inside they share the same kind heart.
表面上，這對姊妹看起來非常不同，但在內心深處她們有著同樣善良的心。
surrender to the police: After hiding in the mountains for three days, the thief finally decided to surrender to the police.
在山裡躲了三天之後，那個小偷終於決定向警方自首。
surrender one's passport: Because he might run away, the man had to surrender his passport to the court until the trial was over.
由於他可能逃跑，這名男子必須向法院交出護照，直到審判結束。
surrender to temptation: I promised to stop eating sweets, but when I saw the chocolate cake, I could not help but surrender to temptation.
我答應要戒甜食，但看到巧克力蛋糕時，我忍不住屈服於誘惑。
surrender control: Some parents find it hard to surrender control and let their teenage children make their own choices.
有些父母覺得很難交出控制權，讓青少年子女自己做選擇。
never surrender: Our coach told us to never surrender, even when we were losing by ten points in the last quarter.
教練告訴我們永不投降，即使在最後一節落後十分也一樣。
surrender one's rights: By signing this unfair contract, the workers would surrender their rights to get paid for working overtime.
簽下這份不公平的合約，工人們就會放棄領取加班費的權利。
